name: fh-datastar-view-frontend
description: Frontend sources for the Datastar dashboard: the page shell's inlined helpers and the /edit editor (CodeMirror 6 + @codemirror/lsp-client). Vite bundles src/js into target/frontend, which sbt's NpmPlugin folds into the module's managed resources — so nothing built is committed. Driven by sbt (frontendInstall / frontendBundle); the npm scripts are what it calls.

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && vite build --mode shell && vite build --mode app && vite build --mode overlay
